en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, form Hammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Everything what you speak to Allahazwj with during an Obligatory Salāt, so there is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whatever (words) with which you speak to Allah in Salah (prayer) is not harmful.’” (Ahadith 4-5 of this Chapter are best explained by fatwas.)
